banglaExplanation: CB assessment তৈরি করার সময় চারটি principles মানতে হয়।
Validity মানে যা assess করার কথা, ঠিক সেটাই assess করা।
Fairness মানে বয়স, gender, disability বা ভাষার কারণে কেউ পিছিয়ে পড়বে না।
Assessment বানানোর পর মিলিয়ে দেখুন, এই চারটি principles মানা হয়েছে কি না।

example.bn: পড়তে কষ্ট হয় এমন candidate-কে মুখে উত্তর দিতে দেওয়া fairness-এর উদাহরণ।
example.en: A driving test centre lets a candidate with weak reading answer questions orally. This keeps the test fair.

bn: চারটা principle: Validity, Reliability, Flexibility, Fairness। মনে রাখো "VRFF"।
Designer-কে নিজে check করতে হবে design এই চারটা মানছে কি না।

Candidate চাইলে assessment-কে challenge করতে পারে, আর তখন re-assessment দিতে হবে।

Reliability — methods আর procedures সবসময় একইভাবে বোঝা ও প্রয়োগ করা হয়, তাই ফলাফলে ভরসা করা যায়।
Flexibility — knowledge, skills, delivery modes আর candidates-এর প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী assessment মানিয়ে নেওয়া যায়।
Fairness — যোগ্য সব candidates assessment দিতে পারে, কেউ অসুবিধায় পড়ে না।

short.modelAnswer:
Fairness: assessments are accessible to all eligible candidates, regardless of age, gender, disability, background, language or location. No one is disadvantaged by the procedures or methods.
Fairness can be achieved by:
1. A transparent assessment process
2. Consulting candidates on purpose, methods and procedures
3. Providing and seeking informative feedback
4. Making challenges and appeals accessible to all candidates

and allows reasonable adjustments and appeal rights when needed, without
lowering competency standards.

title: Principles of Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Other principles that should inform the development and conduct of CB Assessment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Authenticity
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Currency
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Cost-effectiveness
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Reasonable adjustment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

traps.text: Authenticity, currency, cost-effectiveness and reasonable adjustment are other principles, not the main four.

cites.quote: we recognise that there is no single approach to the assessment of performance in a competency-based system
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

traps.text: Flexibility: there is no single approach to the assessment of performance.

cites.quote: attendant carer, scribe
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: use of large print version of any papers
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Examples of Reasonable adjustments include
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

traps.text: Reasonable adjustment examples include a scribe and a large print version of papers.

cites.quote: Assessments are valid when they assess what they claim to assess
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Assessments assess what they claim to assess.

cites.quote: Assessments will cover the range of skills and knowledge sufficient to demonstrate competency
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Assessment of competence should integrate knowledge and skills with their practical application
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: made on evidence gathered on a number of occasions and in a variety of situations
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Cover enough skills and knowledge. Integrate knowledge and skills with practical application. Judge on evidence from many occasions and situations.

cites.quote: assessors are fully aware of what is to be assessed, as indicated by clearly defined performance or assessment criteria
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: evidence is collected from activities and tasks that can be clearly related to the unit of competency
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: evidence demonstrates that the performance or assessment criteria have been met
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: evidence is sufficient, ie the units/elements of competency or learning outcomes have been suitably sampled
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Assessors know what is assessed from clearly defined criteria. Evidence relates to the unit, shows criteria are met and is sufficient.

cites.quote: Assessments are reliable when the methods and procedures used are consistently interpreted and applied over time
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Methods and procedures are consistently interpreted and applied over time.

cites.quote: Assessment practices should be monitored and reviewed to ensure that there is consistency in the interpretation of evidence
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Assessors must be competent in terms of the national competency standards for assessment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Monitor and review practices for consistent interpretation of evidence. Assessors must be competent against national assessment standards.

cites.quote: administering assessments in the same way for each candidate
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: ensuring that instructions to candidates are clear, consistent and unambiguous
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: ensuring that assessors use well planned guides
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: making sure that assessment events are 'just right' neither too hard nor too easy
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: evaluating and revising the assessment tools and their results with other assessors
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Administer each candidate the same way. Give clear instructions. Use well planned guides. Keep events 'just right'. Review tools with other assessors.

cites.quote: Assessments are flexible when they are appropriate to the range of knowledge, skills and attitudes encompassed by competency standards
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: the range of delivery modes and locations as well as the needs of a wide range of candidates
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Appropriate to the range of knowledge, skills, delivery modes, locations and candidates' needs.

cites.quote: there is no single approach to the assessment of performance
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: assessment practices reflect a consideration of the widest range of direct, indirect and supplementary evidence
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Accept there is no single approach to assessing performance. Consider the widest range of direct, indirect and supplementary evidence.

cites.quote: Assessments are fair when they are accessible to all eligible candidates
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: no one is disadvantaged by the procedures or methods used
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Accessible to all eligible candidates. No one is disadvantaged by the procedures or methods.

cites.quote: Assessment practices and methods are equitable for all groups of learners or candidates
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Assessment procedures and the criteria for judging performance are made clear
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: There should be a participatory approach to the conduct of assessment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: jointly developed and agreed between assessor and the candidate
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: Opportunities must be provided to allow learners/candidates to challenge assessments and provision must be made for re-assessment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Equitable methods. Clear procedures and criteria. A participatory approach, jointly developed and agreed. Chances to challenge, and re-assessment.

cites.quote: ensuring that the assessment process is 'transparent'
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: consulting candidates on the purpose, methods and procedures for assessment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: providing and seeking informative feedback throughout the assessment process
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: making challenges and appeals accessible to all candidates
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: A transparent process. Consult candidates. Provide and seek feedback. Make challenges and appeals accessible.

cites.quote: When designing assessment tools that use indirect evidence, e.g. work samples
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: establish that indirect evidence is the work of the candidate and not someone else's
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Indirect evidence, such as work samples, must be the candidate's own work.

cites.quote: you need to ensure that the assessors check on authenticity
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: You should collect more direct evidence if in doubt
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Assessors check authenticity. Collect more direct evidence if in doubt.

cites.quote: When assessment tools also rely on evidence such as samples, references and qualifications, ensure you check on their currency
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Check the currency of samples, references and qualifications.

cites.quote: If currency is in doubt, look for more direct evidence
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: If currency is in doubt, look for more direct evidence.

cites.quote: ensure that the assessment methods and activities are cost-effective in terms of both time and financial costs
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Methods and activities are cost-effective in time and financial costs.

cites.quote: an individual with a disability (or temporary disability) is not presented with artificial barriers when demonstrating achievement of competence
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: An individual with a disability is not presented with artificial barriers.

cites.quote: provision of personal support services (e.g. reader, interpreter, attendant carer, scribe), use of special equipment
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

cites.quote: or adaptive technology, shorter assessment sessions to allow for fatigue or medication, use of large print version of any papers
cites.sourceTitle: Design and Develop Competency Based Assessment

rows.text: Personal support (reader, interpreter, carer, scribe), special equipment, adaptive technology, shorter sessions, large print papers.
